milestones.name: Enter Forgotten Crossroads
milestones.note: Player drops down the well from Dirtmouth into Forgotten Crossroads

milestones.name: Meet Quirrel
milestones.note: Quirrel stands outside the sealed Temple of the Black Egg

milestones.name: Find Cornifer
milestones.note: Cornifer sells the Forgotten Crossroads map for 30 Geo; unlocks Iselda's shop in Dirtmouth

milestones.name: Rescue Grub 1
milestones.note: Grub in a jar just beyond the Husk Guard in the eastern section

milestones.name: Rescue Grub 2
milestones.note: Grub reachable via pogo off Vengefly; requires Monarch Wings or Crystal Heart normally, but early pogo trick possible

milestones.name: Rescue Grub 3
milestones.note: Grub found in section with acid pool, near Aspid Hunter

milestones.name: Rescue Grub 4
milestones.note: Grub found in section left of the Gruz Mother arena ascent

milestones.name: Rescue Grub 5
milestones.note: Grub in hidden room revealed by striking a wall; guarded by 2x Aspid Hunter

milestones.name: Defeat Gruz Mother
milestones.note: Two-phase fight; second phase spawns Gruzzers. Unlocks path eastward and access to Sly

milestones.name: Save Sly
milestones.note: Sly found in cave near Gruz Mother arena; talking to him sends him to Dirtmouth to open his shop

milestones.name: Unlock Forgotten Crossroads Stag Station
milestones.note: Pay 50 Geo and strike bell to call The Last Stag

milestones.name: Defeat False Knight
milestones.note: False Knight drops City Crest upon defeat; unlocks path to Ancestral Mound

milestones.name: Obtain City Crest
milestones.note: Key item dropped by False Knight

milestones.name: Reach Ancestral Mound
milestones.note: Sub-area accessible after defeating False Knight

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.fingerprintHint: Central hub area beneath Dirtmouth; connects many parts of Hallownest; acid pools, Goam hazards, spiked pits, hot spring, bench, stag station

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.fingerprintHint: Previous area above the well; home to Iselda and Sly shops after events

zones.name: Temple of the Black Egg
zones.fingerprintHint: Sealed stone egg structure in eastern Forgotten Crossroads; Quirrel stands outside

zones.name: Ancestral Mound
zones.fingerprintHint: Sub-area reachable from western end of Forgotten Crossroads after False Knight defeat

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads Stag Station
zones.fingerprintHint: Stag station inside Forgotten Crossroads; costs 50 Geo to activate; connects to Dirtmouth via Last Stag

abilities.name: Monarch Wings
abilities.note: Referenced as required to normally reach a high Grub and Salubra's shop; not acquired in this segment

abilities.name: Crystal Heart
abilities.note: Referenced as alternative to Monarch Wings for reaching high Grub; not acquired in this segment

abilities.name: Mantis Claw
abilities.note: Referenced as required to reach Salubra's shop; not acquired in this segment

abilities.name: City Crest
abilities.note: Dropped by False Knight; key item with implied use elsewhere

abilities.name: Wayward Compass
abilities.note: Charm purchasable from Iselda in Dirtmouth; recommended for exploration

abilities.name: Quill
abilities.note: Purchasable from Iselda in Dirtmouth; needed for map exploration

bosses.name: Gruz Mother
bosses.note: Two-phase boss: fight her, then kill ~7-8 Gruzzers that burst from her. Drops Geo. Sleeping when found; wake by striking with The Nail.

bosses.name: False Knight
bosses.note: Falls from ceiling triggering boss fight; drops City Crest. Must be struck in head after ground breaks to finish him and open locked gate.
